subject: english
question:
Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.

He hesitated, studying her face with a (confused) expression.
solution:
The correct answer is "**puzzled**." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes someone studying another person's face with a confused expression. 
 
 
• **"Confused" means not being able to think clearly.**(अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• Example: She was confused between vanilla and chocolate.
 
 
 
• **"Puzzled" means not able to understand or explain something.** (किसी बात को) समझने या समझाने में असमर्थ, उलझन-ग्रस्‍त
 
 
• Example: She gave me a puzzled expression.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "puzzled" is the synonym of the word "confused."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) assisted means helped, which does not fit the context of the sentence.(सहायता देना)
 
• Option 2) explicated means explained, which also does not fit the context of the sentence.(समझाया)
 
• Option 3) calm means peaceful or relaxed, which is the opposite of what the sentence is describing.(शांत)
